sentences: Patient is a 69-year-old woman with low back pain for about four months.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Works as a school bus driver.
Referred to physical therapy at the last visit.
Straight leg raise is positive on the right at 45 degrees.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
